Five family members die in Raipur after consuming poisoned sweets

Five members of a family in Raipur have died after allegedly consuming sweets laced with poison. The incident, which appears to be a case of mass suicide, is under investigation by a Special Investigation Team (SIT). Initial reports suggest the father may have administered the poison through sweets to the family before taking his own life.
